note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc9494): "If the timer for the Long-Lived Stale Time for a given AFI/SAFI expires before the session is re-established, the helper MUST delete all stale routes of that AFI/SAFI from the neighbor that it is retaining." purgeStaleCommand moved in 30ff1fce91: dispatchSentLifecycle now returns a refusal, and the command reports statusError with purgeStaleRefused after the purge. The deletion itself is unchanged and unconditional: RemoveFamilyMatching still removes every entry with StaleLevel > StaleLevelFresh for the family before the dispatch, and best-path changes are still published; the refusal only reports that a destination would not take the withdrawal. The tagged units still observe the stale routes absent at expiry. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
